_comment: 15B stage-1 WSD mix (t46, fb 2026-08-31). The 30B table (mix_30b.json) scaled to 15e9, with math_owm/cot BOUND TO LANDED/POD-EXISTING DATA because OpenWebMath/proof-pile/OpenThoughts/Skywork are not fetched -- stage 1 buys an early read on the math/cot bet at half the tokens, without waiting on those fetches. SCALED-15B TARGET -> STAGE-1 ACTUAL (deviation per role, in tokens): code_rp1t 4.000B -> 6.064B (+2.064B); code_tests 1.000B -> 1.000B (0); math_owm -> math_seed 2.750B -> 0.245B (-2.505B); cot 2.250B -> 1.272B (-0.978B); en_c4 2.750B -> 4.169B (+1.419B); zh_web 1.650B -> 1.650B (0); textbook_30b 0.500B -> 0.500B (0); wiki_chat 0.100B -> 0.100B (0). math+cot: 5.000B -> 1.517B (-3.483B); the whole shortfall is reassigned to code_rp1t + en_c4 in their existing 8:5.5 ratio (8/13.5 = +2.064B to code_rp1t, 5.5/13.5 = +1.419B to en_c4). MEASURED SUPPLIES (44, t49, train.encode exact -- byte estimates were 1.9-5.2x off and are NOT used): math_seed = 81,681,834 tokens (5 shards, 320M bytes; 74.27M English 91% + 7.41M Chinese 9%); cot (numina) = 424,056,227 tokens (13 shards, 851,965 docs). Both at epochs=3, the cap (fb: epoch cap <=3) -- epochs=3 is FORCED, not chosen: 81.68M x 3 = 245M = math_seed demand and 424M x 3 = 1.272B = cot demand, so check_mix_supply FAILs at epochs<=2. COT_SEED DROPPED (fb ruling 2026-08-31): fable5_traces + fable5_sft = 4,665 snippets all under 100 characters, 0 kept under light filters -- not trainable corpus. cot = numina alone (fb ruling). MATH SHORTFALL RULE (fb ruling 2026-08-31): de starts the finemath clean in parallel (~5 min workers); it stamps no later than code_rp1t, which gates the launch anyway. At code_rp1t stamp: if math_owm is stamped too, re-cut with the measured finemath tokens (target 2.75B, epochs 1); if it is not, launch as-cut with the shortfall in code/en and math_owm noted as the first stage-2 addition. No third option. math_owm is the only open number. When finemath lands, math_owm = finemath (primary, epochs 1) + math_seed (top-up <=3 epochs). math_seed/cot are NEW stamped dirs, not ladder names (web_hq/textbook/en/math/code/wiki/chat stay banned). ANNEAL: anneal_frac = 0 (WSD stage 1 -- no anneal phase). Launch flags: --warmdown 0 --anneal_frac 0 (stage 1 keeps lr at stable, ends at lr_mult 1.0); stage 2 resumes at lr_mult 1.0 and decays with --warmdown 0.10. train.py already handles the falsy-0.0 case (warmdown/anneal_frac are floats whose valid value 0.0 is falsy; the CLI loop would skip them and silently keep the 0.65/0.10 defaults -- train.py:1690 applies them explicitly). NOTE: harness cfg_default('anneal_frac') reads the run config (data/mix_scale_run_config.json), not this mix file -- the anneal_frac field here is the CONTRACT; launch must set it in the run config + CLI. STAGE 2: the remaining 15B runs under mix_30b.json (its weights applied to 15e9 = the scaled-15B target column above) once finemath lands -- real math_owm replaces math_seed, code_rp1t/en_c4 return to their scaled targets. Stage 2 is a RESUME from the stage-1 15B checkpoint, not a fresh run, IF t47 (tlerl's resume rehearsal) confirms the mechanics; otherwise fresh. The stage-1 deviations are front-loaded: stage 1 over-weights code/en and under-weights math/cot relative to the 30B table, and stage 2 does not pay that back (it runs the standard scaled table) -- the two-stage path is a different composition than a straight 30B run, bought for the earlier read. CONTRACT: same three invariants as mix_30b.json -- weights(domains)+weights(_blocked) sum to 1.0 (here 1.00000), no frozen ladder directory name, every landed domain stamped. The harness check check_mix_30b_contract is hardcoded to data/mix_30b.json and does not read this file; the invariants are satisfied here and verified by hand (de to parameterize the check onto mix_*.json when harness.py is free). domains is EMPTY today: no domain is stamped into domains/ (math_seed/cot are measured but still in _blocked until 3b moves them). t46-stage-1 MUST NOT launch until _blocked is empty and weights(domains) sum to 1.0.
